title: Very disappointed!
text: Very disappointed!. These paper towels are very harsh. Not soft at all. I use paper towels instead of napkins at the dinner table and these won't do at all. I was expecting the Choose-A-Size to be half of the normal size but they are only 1 inch shorter. Not enough of a difference. I would not buy these again.
